quarterly_detail: Latest reported quarter is Q4 FY26 (Jan–Mar 2026), reported 2026-04-18 alongside full FY26 annual results. As of the data-collection date (2026-07-09/10), Q1 FY27 (Apr–Jun 2026) results had NOT yet been published — ICICI Bank typically reports Q1 in mid-to-late July. Standalone quarterly trend (Rs Cr, EPS Rs): Mar25 42,431/12,630/17.73 → Jun25 42,947/12,768/17.89 → Sep25 41,758/12,359/17.30 → Dec25 41,966/11,318/15.83 → Mar26 43,275/13,702/19.14. Consolidated quarterly trend: Mar25 48,387/14,354/18.96 → Jun25 49,080/14,456/19.00 → Sep25 48,181/14,318/18.70 → Dec25 48,364/13,481/17.53 → Mar26 49,594/15,681/20.61. Note the Dec25 quarter dipped sequentially on both bases before Mar26 recovered strongly — consistent across both consolidated and standalone tables, so likely a real seasonal/one-off effect (e.g., treasury/provisioning) rather than a data error.
dividends_detail: ICICI Bank pays a single annual (final) dividend rather than quarterly/interim dividends. Trailing-12-month PAID dividend (the figure to use for TTM dividend/yield purposes): Rs 11.00/share, ex-date & record date 2025-08-12, payment date reported inconsistently as either 2025-09-29 (stockanalysis.com) or 2025-09-03 (a separate aggregator snippet) — both agree on the Rs 11.00 amount and Aug 12 ex-date; the pay-date conflict should be resolved against the company's own investor-relations filing if exact settlement date matters. Separately, ICICI Bank declared a Rs 12.00/share final dividend for FY26 on 2026-04-18 (with record date 2026-08-03 and AGM 2026-08-21) — this is DECLARED BUT NOT YET PAID as of the data-collection date and must not be added to the trailing-12-month paid total. No special/one-off dividends were identified in either period. Face value Rs 2.00 throughout.
model_self_report: I am Claude (Sonnet 5), acting as an independent researcher subagent. I used WebSearch and WebFetch exclusively against live internet sources — primarily screener.in (both standalone and consolidated pages, explicitly re-fetched to get raw quarterly-table column headers after an initial fetch mislabeled quarters), plus stockanalysis.com (direct successful fetch), businesstoday.in (direct fetch, dividend record-date article), and multiple WebSearch query aggregations (which surface snippets from tickertape, business-standard, trendlyne, choiceindia, marketsmojo, upstox, investonline, etc., without me independently fetching each underlying page). I attempted direct fetches of NSE (timed out after 60s, likely anti-bot/JS-rendering), BSE (returned only a generic page shell, no data — likely JS-rendered SPA that WebFetch's HTML-to-markdown conversion cannot execute), and MoneyControl (blocked outright by the fetch tool, 'unable to fetch'). This is a real methodological limitation: my NSE/BSE/MoneyControl 'cross-checks' are WebSearch-snippet-level, not independently-fetched primary-page-level, for those three sources. I did NOT touch any localhost or Vysted API. Where sources disagreed (price by up to ~₹6, market cap by ~1%, 52-week return by ~0.6pp, dividend payment date by ~26 days), I recorded both readings rather than silently picking one, per instructions. All growth-rate and drawdown figures were computed by me from the raw quarterly/price figures rather than quoted from a portal, and the arithmetic is shown inline for auditability. Confidence: high on price/mcap/52w-range/quarterly-financials/dividend-amounts/promoter-holding (multi-source agreement); medium on the exact 52-week return % and the exact FY25 dividend pay-date (genuine source conflicts noted above, unresolved).
notes: PRICE DISAGREEMENT: screener.in shows ₹1,381.00 (close, 2026-07-09); stockanalysis.com direct fetch shows ₹1,384.00; WebSearch aggregator snippets showed ₹1,381.60, ₹1,382.60 and ₹1,378.20 for the same/adjacent dates. All within a ~₹6 (0.4%) band — treated as normal cross-portal timing/rounding noise, not a material discrepancy. Used screener.in's ₹1,381.00 as the canonical reference price throughout this pack.

MARKET CAP DISAGREEMENT: screener.in and stockanalysis.com agree at ~₹9.90 lakh crore, but one WebSearch aggregator snippet reported ₹10,01,254.70 Cr (~1.1% higher) — likely a stale or differently-timed share-count basis at that aggregator. Flagged rather than silently reconciled.

P/E DISAGREEMENT: screener.in shows 18.3 (consolidated) / 19.8 (standalone) TTM; stockanalysis.com shows 18.47. The stockanalysis.com figure sits between the two screener figures and its exact EPS basis (standalone vs consolidated vs blended) is not disclosed on that page.

52-WEEK RETURN DISAGREEMENT: stockanalysis.com (direct fetch) states -4.02% 1-year return; a separate WebSearch aggregation (snippet-only, source portal unclear — likely tickertape/marketsmojo-style) states -3.44% price return / -3.58% market-cap change. Genuine unresolved conflict of ~0.6pp; both are plausible year-on-year figures given the 52w range of 1,187.60–1,500.00.

DIVIDEND PAY-DATE DISAGREEMENT: the Rs 11.00 FY25 final dividend's ex-date/record date (2025-08-12) is consistent everywhere, but the actual payment date is given as 2025-09-29 by stockanalysis.com and 2025-09-03 by a separate WebSearch snippet. Not resolved — recommend checking ICICI Bank's own investor-relations page or an exchange corporate-action filing if the exact settlement date is load-bearing.

DIVIDEND YIELD 'DISAGREEMENT' IS NOT AN ERROR: screener's 0.80% uses the trailing PAID Rs 11 dividend; other portals' 0.87–0.88% use the newly DECLARED (unpaid) Rs 12 dividend annualized against the current price. Both are internally consistent given their stated basis — flagged for basis clarity, not as a data quality issue.

METHODOLOGY LIMITATION: direct WebFetch of nseindia.com timed out (likely bot-protection/JS rendering), bseindia.com returned only a generic non-data page shell, and moneycontrol.com was blocked outright by the fetch tool ('unable to fetch'). Cross-checks against NSE/BSE/MoneyControl in this pack are therefore via WebSearch snippet aggregation only, not independent primary-page fetches. screener.in and stockanalysis.com were the only two sources independently, directly fetched and read in full.

QUARTER-LABELING CAUTION: an initial WebFetch of screener.in's quarterly table mislabeled the most recent column as 'Q3 FY26 – Dec 2024' (an internally inconsistent label — Dec 2024 is actually Q3 FY25). This was an artifact of the WebFetch tool's summarizing sub-model, not of screener.in itself. It was caught and corrected by re-fetching with an explicit request for raw column headers, which confirmed columns run through Mar 2026 (Q4 FY26) and that Q1 FY27 has not yet been reported as of 2026-07-09/10.

PROMOTER HOLDING: ICICI Bank has held 0.00% promoter shareholding since its 2002 reverse merger with erstwhile ICICI Limited (and associated entities); this is a structural feature of the bank, not a data gap. Confirmed consistently across screener.in and WebSearch cross-check.

Both standalone and consolidated figures are provided throughout because ICICI Bank's consolidated financials include large insurance (ICICI Prudential Life/ICICI Lombard) and asset-management subsidiaries that materially change revenue, net profit, EPS, book value and ROE versus the standalone (bank-only) financials. Neither basis is 'wrong' — pick per use case; this pack defaults to presenting both side by side rather than silently choosing one.
